preconditions.expression: isinstance(image, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in image) and len(image) > 0
preconditions.description: image is a non-empty 2D list of integers.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(pixel, int) and 0 <= pixel <= 10 for pixel in row) for row in image)
preconditions.description: All pixel values in the image are integers between 0 and 10 inclusive.
The starting coordinates (sr, sc) are within the bounds of the image.
newColor is an integer between 0 and 10 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(image) and all(len(row) == len(image[0]) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: The returned image has the same dimensions as the input image.
The starting pixel is updated to the newColor.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[r][c] == newColor if (r, c) in {(r, c) for r in range(len(image)) for c in range(len(image[0])) if any(image[rr][cc] == image[sr][sc] and (rr == r and cc == c or (rr == r and abs(cc - c) == 1) or (abs(rr - r) == 1 and cc == c)) for rr in range(len(image)) for cc in range(len(image[0])) if (rr, cc) in {(rr, cc) for rr in range(len(image)) for cc in range(len(image[0])) if image[rr][cc] == image[sr][sc] and (rr == r and cc == c or (rr == r and abs(cc - c) == 1) or (abs(rr - r) == 1 and cc == c))}) else image[r][c] for r in range(len(image)) for c in range(len(image[0])))
postconditions.description: All pixels 4-directionally connected to the starting pixel with the same original color are updated to newColor, and all other pixels remain unchanged.
